data.one_liner: Flutter RuStore Review SDK for requesting app ratings and reviews.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications targeting Android to prompt users for ratings and reviews using the RuStore review system. It provides an imperative client interface to initialize the SDK, check request eligibility, and display the review flow dialog.
use_when: You are distributing your Flutter application on RuStore for Android.
You want to prompt users for ratings and reviews directly inside your app.
avoid_when: Your app targets platforms other than Android.
You are distributing exclusively through Google Play Store or Apple App Store.
strengths: Official integration for RuStore review SDK.
Straightforward API for initialization and review requests.
weaknesses: Limited to Android and specific RuStore operating conditions.
Requires proper release signing configuration and specific app IDs for the sample/testing.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android OS 7.0+, an updated RuStore app installed, user logged into RuStore, and correct applicationId and signing configurations.
